thread:
mira_h: quick q — ran the nightly SCIM deprovision job and noticed UID 2345 still active even though their last group was removed. anyone seen nested-group deprovision fail like this? :thinking:

alex_w: can you paste the scim delta and the mapping we're using? also, did the connector logs show the group removal event?

mira_h: pasted payload below (sanitized):
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {
      "op": "remove",
      "path": "groups[value eq \"eng-frontend\"]"
    }
  ]
}
```
logs show: `scim: patch user 2345 remove group eng-frontend -> success` but user still shows in console.

samir_r: two quick things to check: 1) is the SCIM connector configured to expand nested groups? if the group that was removed was a parent of another active group, the connector might not collapse membership. 2) do we have a "retain_on_unmap" flag in our mapping rules that prevents deprovision?

mira_h: checked — not in any other explicit groups. looks like eng-frontend is a member of eng-all (nested). i suspect the connector is not expanding. @ops-bot any config changes on scim-sync recently?

ops-bot: Automated: scim-sync job run at 2026-01-15T03:12:00Z completed. Connector image: redwood/scim-connector:v3.4.1. No config changes detected in last 7 days.

jordan_pm: if we need to run a manual expand/deprovision we will need security approval to access the audit logs and run the job. @ida can you approve read-only audit + ops exec for 1 hour?

ida: I can approve a 2-hour read-only window for security/ops to run diagnostics. Please post the justification and list of UIDs involved.

alex_w: for repro/fix flow — try a dry-run first:
```bash
# dry-run expand nested groups and show diff
./scim-sync --tenant redwood --dry-run --resolve-nested-groups 
# if output looks good, run live deprovision for user
./service users deprovision --uid 2345 --confirm
```
Also note: the sync output contains emails — redact before pasting externally.

samir_r: to redact logs quickly: `jq` snippet below masks emails and tokens:
```bash
jq '.users |= map(.email = "REDACTED", .token = "REDACTED")' scim-sync-output.json > redacted.json
```
Use `/tools/redact` if you want UI-driven redaction.

mira_h: running the dry-run now, will paste redacted diff. if dry-run indicates nested membership wasn't expanded then we need to flip `expand_groups = true` in connector and schedule a live run (post-approval). submitted access request with justification: "investigate orphaned account after SCIM patch; UIDs: 2345" — link: https://redwood.atlassian.org/req/SCIM-ACCESS-452. will update when approved :thumbsup:

alex_w: FYI, if we change `expand_groups` we should also bump connector to v3.4.2 (hotfix) — that image includes nested expansion bugfix. otherwise we could get partial membership deltas.

mira_h: noted. thanks all — i'll wait for ida approval then run live.
